response.original_title: Sutukai Aijanu Maya Gaijamla Relaima Chadera
response.overview: Sutukai Aijanu Maya Gaijamla Relaima Chadera is a romantic musical story about a dream boy who always wishes to become a film hero. One day, while walking with his sister near Gokarna Shaheed Smarak Park in Kathmandu, he sees a film song being shot. Excited by the cameras, lights, music, and dancers, he asks his sister to go closer. Among the dancers, he notices a beautiful girl whose graceful dance immediately captures his heart. He begins to imagine himself as the hero of the song, dancing and romancing with her. In his dream, they share joyful and romantic moments filled with love, laughter, and chemistry. He expresses his feelings and even proposes marriage, dreaming of spending their lives together. At the end of the song, the girl whispers in his ear, “Let’s go together.” Suddenly, the director says, “Okay, cut!” and the dream boy returns to reality. His sister takes him home, leaving him with a beautiful dream of love and his wish to become a film hero.
response.title: Sutukai Aijanu Maya Gaijamla Relaima Chadera
